text:
Maya R: hey team — heads up i'm stuck at the airport, flight pushed. need someone to take primary tonight 18:00-02:00. i can stay shadow until 20:00 if needed :airplane:
Adrian K: i can cover 18:00-23:00 if that helps. who wants the late 23-02 slot?
Karen L: i can take 23-02 but need a quick runbook handover. maya, any open incidents or pages i should know about?
Maya R: no active incidents right now. quick check: last night's surge on embeddings is resolved, but ops-bot flagged a slow tail for eu-region reroutes — stack says intermittent 503s to model-proxy. i left notes in #incidents, and linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prim-sec-handoff (see section "eu reroute followup")
IncidentBot: :warning: Incident alert created (INC-2026-0423). Severity: P2. Affected: hosted-api embeddings (eu). Pager tickets: pagerduty.com/INC-2026-0423
Samir P: thx. karen, if you take 23-02, ping me at 22:50 and i'll shadow the first 20min for handoff. i can also handle escalation if PD goes to sev1.
Karen L: noted. maya, quick checklist before i take over: 1) latest canary model id, 2) any active canary deploys, 3) credentials/token for private clusters?
Maya R: canary model id: model-redwood-emb-v2, no active deploys. creds — don't share secrets in slack, use vault link: vault.redwood/internal/teams/eng-oncall (i've added a short note there).
Adrian K: i'll update the rota spreadsheet and set primary in PagerDuty to Adrian (18:00-23:00) and then to Karen (23:00-02:00). i also enabled forward-on-miss for the 23:00 handover window.
Maya R: thanks adrian. also left a mini runbook snippet here for quick ops:
```
Checkpoints for handoff:
- Confirm pager route (pd -> primary)
- Verify model-proxy pods in eu cluster (kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=model-proxy)
- Tail logs for 5m: kubectl logs -f deploy/model-proxy --since=5m
- If 503 spike, toggle fallback route: /ops/routing/fallback (admin panel)
- Notify customers via status.redwood.ai if degraded > 10m
```
Karen L: good checklist. adrian, can you paste the pd change commands?
Adrian K: sure — in case anyone needs it: `curl -X POST https://api.pagerduty.com/oncalls/override -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_TOKEN" -d '{"user_id":"<user>","start":"2026-04-23T18:00:00Z","end":"2026-04-24T02:00:00Z"}'` — i'll run it now.
IncidentBot: :information_source: PagerDuty schedule updated: primary -> Adrian K (18:00-23:00), then -> Karen L (23:00-02:00).
Samir P: one more ask — if you see customer-impact traces > 5% errors, please make the call to page SRE L2. we've got an open ticket template: https://redwood.internal/templates/customer-impact (fill short blurb + link to logs).
Maya R: confirmed. adrian, if you hit anything you can't mitigate, failover plan is to pin to model-redwood-emb-v1 (older but stable). i've added rollback command in vault note.
Adrian K: copied. starting rotation takeover in 10. maya — safe travels. i'll DM you the capture if anything happens while you're in transit. :thumbsup:
Maya R: thanks everyone. karen i'll DM creds re: shadow. leaving note: customer-facing latency spike looks tied to eu cache invalidations — watch the cache invalidation job at cron `*/15 * * * *` in ops namespace.
Karen L: copying that. i'll be online at 22:45 for the handoff and will run the `kubectl logs -f` snippet.
Maya R: last note — want to avoid noisy page loops. please set PD escalation to 3min -> 6min for this window (adrian/PD setting) so late-night wakeups are minimized.
Adrian K: done. escalation policy updated for this booking window.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Handoff confirmed. Primary coverage: Adrian K 18:00-23:00, Karen L 23:00-02:00. Shadowing: Maya R until 20:00, Samir P available for escalation. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prim-sec-handoff
Samir P: thanks. i'll be reachable if PD goes > sev1. gl everyone.
Karen L: thanks — see you all in the notes.
Maya R: appreciate it, closing thread.
